name: Build-Up Dominoes
description: Build-Up Dominoes is a western domino connecting game that uses two double-six sets to increase tile availability for larger tables and longer hands. Players place legal matching tiles to open ends and try to manage mobility and pip exposure while progressing toward hand-end conditions.

content.text: Build-Up Dominoes is a western domino connecting game that uses two double-six sets to increase tile availability for larger tables and longer hands. Players place legal matching tiles to open ends and try to manage mobility and pip exposure while progressing toward hand-end conditions.
Build-Up Dominoes is encountered as a modern expanded-supply connecting format that uses two standard domino sets to reduce early blocking and support larger tables.
Two double-6 domino sets shuffled together.
Domino sets and optional score tracking by table profile.
Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard by table profile.
